---

Read the two raw files from `data/_raw/` and write `data/01_dat_load.tsv` and `data/01_dat_load_meta.tsv`. Leave the raw files unchanged.

`N/A` is used for missing clinical fields. Empty HLA cells are just blank strings, those stay in until cleaning. `read_csv()` also renames the duplicated HLA columns (`HLA-A`, `HLA-A`, ...) to `HLA-A...9` and so on.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

dir.create(here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

peptide_data <- read_csv(
  here("data", "_raw", "peptide-detail-ci.csv"),
  na = "N/A"
)

meta_data <- read_csv(
  here("data", "_raw", "subject-metadata.csv"),
  na = "N/A"
)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(peptide_data, here("data", "01_dat_load.tsv"))
write_tsv(meta_data, here("data", "01_dat_load_meta.tsv"))

peptide_data |> slice_head(n = 3)
meta_data |> slice_head(n = 3)
```
